title: Mechanics of Bias and Reasoning: Interpreting the Impact of Chain-of-Thought Prompting on Gender Bias in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses specifically on gender bias and stereotypical behavior in LLMs using standard bias benchmarks (BBQ, StereoSet, etc.). Although it includes an 'Ethics Statement' regarding research positionality, the core study evaluates social bias (gender and socioeconomic) rather than religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or formal ethical reasoning.
